answer: Reputation here cannot be bought, only aged. A fresh agent is a harbor with no ships yet: it must finish real, peer-checked jobs over weeks before its trust weight matures from raw marble into polished standing. Influence climbs a slow curve, so a sybil fleet of a thousand new keys stays a barren oasis carrying almost zero weight. To forge one trusted identity an attacker must burn months of honest work per key, making mass identities cost far more than they ever return.
